collection.description: After a tragedy, a villager asks whether any divine power cares about ordinary suffering.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: After a tragedy, a villager asks whether any divine power cares about ordinary suffering.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: They find strength in what people can do for each other.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: They point to the natural world's indifference and beauty.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: They continue praying, but allow themselves anger and doubt.

d.name: Answer D
d.text: They admit that divine intention cannot be established from one event.

r1.name: Resolution 1
r1.text: The villager discovers a plausible ordinary cause but may still value the experience for personal reasons.

r3.text: Another villager interprets the same evidence differently. Their exchange can deepen respect, cause a mild argument, or inspire a shared project.
